Job Title : Ecom Front End Developer
Location : Bolingbrook, IL.
Duration : CTH

Job Description:

Retail Ecom

Must Have Skills:
· Strong experience in REACT, HTML5, CSS3, JQuery and JavaScript

Desired Skills:
· GIT, REDUX,MVC, Test Driven Methodologies , Jasmine, SaaS and BEM

Roles and Responsibilities:
· 8 + years of experience in front-end development and is fluent in HTML5, CSS3, browsers standards, JQuery and JavaScript standards. 
· Deep experience with JavaScript and REACT framework. REACT experience is mandatory for this position. 
· Preferred to have GIT, REDUX,MVC, Test Driven Methodologies , Jasmine, SaaS and BEM in your past projects 
· Positive, proactive and collaborative while also demonstrating humility 
· Experience in agile environments and comfortable with quick iterations 
· Experience in leading a team by mentoring or training others 
· Deep experience working with responsive layouts and doesn’t rely on responsive frameworks


Thanks & Regards



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
